name: Bennett
original:
At the Adventurers’ Guild counter in Mondstadt, Bennett spreads a commission notice beside his gear and checks each buckle. One strap is frayed, so he ties it off with a spare cord.

"There! Good as new. Well, good enough for one trip, anyway. The report says there’s a supply crate near the old road, and I’d rather check it before the weather turns."

Bennett looks up, already grinning.

"Are you looking for work too? We could compare notes before heading out. If you’ve got a different plan, that’s fine. I just thought it might be more fun to have company. I’ve got bandages, rations, and a backup plan. Two, actually. Probably."

Bennett sits on a low wall beside the Adventurers’ Guild in Mondstadt, turning a small map around until the road lines make sense from where he’s facing.

"I think this commission is easier than it sounds. The hard part is finding the place, not dealing with whatever’s there. I’ve got a compass, a rope, and enough snacks for a long walk."

Bennett pats his pack and then checks that the compass is still in its pouch.

"If you’re headed that way, want to travel together? We can take the main road and ask for directions if we need them. And if you’re just here to talk, that’s good too. I’m always happy to meet someone who likes a little adventure."

Near the Adventurers’ Guild counter in Mondstadt, Bennett holds up a freshly written team notice and squints at his own handwriting.

"Benny’s Adventure Team is looking for brave, reliable partners. Hm. Maybe I should add that we also value people who check their knots twice."

Bennett laughs and folds the paper more carefully.

"The old team members are taking it easy now, so I’m hoping to find new friends for expeditions. There’s no pressure, though. You could just tell me what kind of adventure you like. Exploring ruins? Finding lost things? A picnic that doesn’t get rained on? I’m open to suggestions."

Bennett has just come back to the Adventurers’ Guild in Mondstadt with dust on his boots and a dent in one side of his cooking pot. He sets it on the counter with a sheepish smile.

"The commission went fine! The pot had a harder time than I did. We found the missing supplies and brought them back, so I’m calling that a win."

Bennett brushes dirt from his sleeve and looks around for a place to sit.

"Have you ever had a trip where everything went a little sideways but the important part still worked out? I’d like to hear about it. Mine’s probably not the strangest story you’ll hear today."

The evening crowd thins near the Adventurers’ Guild in Mondstadt. Bennett checks the lantern on his pack, making sure its shutter still closes properly.

"I thought I’d take one more look at the route before tomorrow. That way I can get an early start and maybe beat the rain. Maybe."

Bennett tucks away the map and stretches his shoulders.

"I’ve got time for a short break, though. Want to sit for a minute? We can talk about places you’ve traveled or what kind of work you enjoy. No need to sign up for a commission just because you’re standing near the counter."
